title: Databricks AI Index: A Completed Task Is Not a Compliant One
description: Databricks AI Index: Unity Gateway firms on one model provider fell from 64% to 28%. Cost per completed task ranks coding models but misses conformance.
og_headline: Databricks AI Index: Completed Is Not Compliant
og_alt: Databricks AI Index: Completed Is Not Compliant. Cost per completed task does not measure whether AI-generated code respects architectural decisions.

reciprocal.desc: Databricks AI Index data on multi-provider use, and why cost per completed task leaves architectural conformance unmeasured.
Another AI index, another blind spot: the Databricks benchmark scores task success and cost, not conformance to a team's decisions.
A per-task companion measure: cost per compliant completed task, for comparing coding models on one repository.
